Jab zameen zoron ke saath zalzale mein aa jaaegi
Aur woh saare khazaane nikaal daalegi
Aur insaan kahega ke ise kya ho gaya hai
Us din woh apni khabrein bayaan karegi
Ke tumhaare Parwardigar ne ise ishaara kiya hai
Us roz saare insaan giroh-dar-giroh qabron se niklenge taake apne aamaal ko dekh sakein
Phir jis shakhs ne zarra baraabar neki ki hai woh use dekhega
Aur jis ne zarra baraabar buraai ki hai woh use dekhega
